title: MES job envelope
description: Response of POST /api/v1/jobs/ (202) and GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/. The result of a succeeded job is the mes-result document, served by GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/result/. The XML representation (mes-job.xsd) carries the same content.

errors.description: Why the job failed; empty unless status is failed.
